verdict.rationale: Motion has a public REST API for creating, updating and managing projects and tasks, with a full endpoint reference and cookbooks. A probe confirmed the API is live and enforces X-API-Key auth, so scripted, non-UI automation from a CI job is feasible, and Zapier offers another automation path. However, nothing in the evidence shows a CLI, SDK, or CI-specific headless guidance, so CI automation means hand-rolling HTTP calls. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/pipeline integration, and independent hands-on reports of headless or CI use.
